newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's ILP buys 42 pct stake in Mills Pacific.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's ILP buys 42 pct stake in Mills Pacific.

text.p: Irish-based specialist packaging company ILP Group said on Tuesday it had agreed to subscribe for 1,991 new shares in Mills Pacific Corporation of Portland, Oregon at a price of around $126.2 per share, payable in cash.
The total consideration payable for the shares is around $251,230 and will give ILP a shareholding of around 41.87 percent in Mills Pacific.

"The acquisition is part of the ILP Group's stated strategy of establishing a strong presence in strategic locations worldwide where electronic and original equipment manufacturers are concentrated," ILP said in a statement.
Mills Pacific was founded two years ago and specialises in advanced packaging design and logistics controls.
The acquisition is expected to be completed on or before February 10 subject to ILP completing a due diligence investigation to its reasonable satisfaction.
The investment should enhance the speed and flexibility of ILP's service to the high-tech electronics sector and assist the growth of the group, the company said.
